name: 77833 · Brenham, TX
findings: ZIP 77833 (Brenham) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77833 (Brenham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77833 (Brenham) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
